subject: sociology

items.q: Does school success depend only on natural intelligence?
items.correct: No — class, gender, ethnicity and school factors all shape achievement.
items.misconception: Yes, achievement is purely about ability.
items.random_wrong: Social background has no effect on education.
items.why: Material and cultural factors and processes within schools strongly influence outcomes.

items.q: Can factors inside school affect achievement?
items.correct: Yes — labelling, setting and teacher expectations can affect results.
items.why: Internal processes like labelling and the self-fulfilling prophecy shape achievement.

specSource: AQA GCSE Sociology (8192) specification; The Sociology of Education
